name: FarmMachineryServiceLog
tagline: Tractors, combines and sprayers serviced on hours, breakdowns fixed fast and every machine ready for the season – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete farm workshop app for farms, agricultural contractors and machinery dealers: log services, breakdowns, operator daily checks and pre-season inspections per machine, track engine hours to the next service, see which machines are down or waiting for parts, run a drag-and-drop workshop board, cost every job (parts, labour, dealer) and compare cost per engine hour across the fleet – with hour-meter checks, failed-check defects, approval of large repairs and seasonal readiness. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Engine hours to the next service per machine (interval per machine or type)
Drag-and-drop workshop board with rule-checked moves
Hour meter that can never go backwards
Parts, labour and dealer cost per job; cost per engine hour per machine and type
Operator daily checks – failed items raise a breakdown job
20 quick filters, grouping, CSV export, bulk assign
Demo mode with a fictional farm fleet
Undo, history notes, read-only and disabled states
